name: calendar_events_patch
description: Updates an event; this method supports patch semantics — only the fields provided in the request are changed. (PATCH /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId})

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method.

description.description: Description of the event. Can contain HTML.

location.description: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

start.description: The (inclusive) start time of the event: object with 'date_time' (RFC3339 timestamp) or 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD), and optional 'time_zone'.

end.description: The (exclusive) end time of the event: object with 'date_time' (RFC3339 timestamp) or 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD), and optional 'time_zone'.

attendees.description: The attendees of the event: JSON list of objects, each with 'email' (required), and optional 'display_name', 'optional' (boolean), 'response_status'. When provided, replaces the whole attendee list.

recurrence.description: List of RRULE lines for a recurring event, as specified in RFC5545, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4"].

color_id.description: The color of the event. This is an ID referring to an entry in the event section of the colors definition.

transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar. 'opaque' or 'transparent'.

send_updates.description: Guests who should receive notifications about the event update. Acceptable values: 'all', 'externalOnly', 'none'. Validated only; no mail is delivered in this sandbox.
